before.input: 4GL field event: runs before the user enters a value for the field.
after.field: 4GL field event: runs after the field value has been accepted.
when.field.changes: 4GL field event: runs when the field value changes.
before.field: 4GL field event: runs when the cursor enters the field.
after.input: 4GL field event: runs after input is complete for the field.
check.input: 4GL field event: validate the field value; can reject input.
on.choice: 4GL choice event: runs when the user activates this choice/command.
before.choice: 4GL choice event: runs before the choice is processed.
after.choice: 4GL choice event: runs after the choice has been processed.
declaration: 4GL section: declare tables, domains, and variables for the script.
functions: 4GL section: local functions used by the UI or report script.
before.program: 4GL program event: runs once when the session starts.
after.program: 4GL program event: runs when the session ends.
on.error: 4GL program event: handles runtime errors for the session.
init.form: 4GL form event: initialize the form when it is first shown.
init.group: 4GL group event: initialize a form group.
selection.filter: 4GL field event: restrict zoom/selection query for the field.
before.save.object: DAL2 hook: validate or prepare data before saving an object.
after.save.object: DAL2 hook: runs after an object was saved successfully.
before.new.object: 4GL program event: runs before a new object is created in the UI session.
after.new.object: DAL2 hook: runs after a new object was created.
before.destroy.object: DAL2 hook: runs before deleting an object.
after.destroy.object: DAL2 hook: runs after an object was deleted.
before.get.object: DAL2 hook: runs before reading an object.
after.get.object: DAL2 hook: runs after an object was read.
set.object.defaults: DAL2 hook: assign default field values for a new object.
method.is.allowed: DAL2 hook: decide whether a DAL method is allowed.
dal.new.object: DAL1: start creating a new business object by table name.
dal.change.object: DAL1: start changing an existing business object.
dal.save.object: DAL1: save the current DAL1 object; returns 0 on success.
dal.destroy.object: DAL1: delete the current DAL1 object.
dal.set.field: DAL1: set a field value on the current object (table.field, value).
dal.new: Create a new DAL object instance in memory.
dal.update: Write pending DAL object changes to the database.
dal.set.error.message: Set an error message for the current DAL hook (often with DALHOOKERROR).
dal.get.error.message: Read the last DAL error message text.
message: Show a message dialog or status message to the user.
mess: Show a coded/library message to the user.
zoom.to$: Open another session (zoom) and optionally return a value.
set.input.error: Mark the current field input as invalid and show an error.
db.retry.point: Mark a database retry point for locked-row retries.
db.insert: Insert the current table buffer row into the database.
db.update: Update the current table buffer row in the database.
db.delete: Delete the current table buffer row from the database.
db.eq: Position on a table row matching the current key values.
db.first: Move to the first row of the current table/set.
db.next: Move to the next row of the current table/set.
db.prev: Move to the previous row of the current table/set.
db.last: Move to the last row of the current table/set.
db.error: Return the last database error code for the process.
db.error.message: Return the text for the last database error.
db.set.to.default: Fill the table buffer with domain default values.
abort.transaction: Roll back the open database transaction.
selectdo: Embedded SQL: body executed for each selected row.
selectempty: Embedded SQL: runs when the select returned no rows.
endselect: Embedded SQL: ends a select / selectdo block.
rprt_open: Open the report device for a print session.
rprt_send: Send the current report line/record to the print device.
execute: Run a standard choice/command (for example print.data).
choice.again: Re-prompt or re-run the previous choice flow.
get.screen.defaults: Load screen default values for range fields.
display: Refresh displayed fields on the form.
len: Return the length of a string.
pos: Find the position of a substring within a string.
strip$: Trim trailing spaces from a string.
str$: Convert a number to a string.
shiftl$: Shift a string left (pad/truncate on the right).
shiftr$: Shift a string right (pad/truncate on the left).
date.num: Return today's date as a LN date number.
date.to.num: Convert a date value to a LN date number.
num.to.date$: Format a LN date number as a date string.
stpapi.put.field: API: put a field value into an open synchronized session.
stpapi.get.field: API: read a field value from an open synchronized session.
stpapi.insert: API: insert via an open synchronized session.
stpapi.update: API: update via an open synchronized session.
stpapi.find: API: find a row via an open synchronized session.
stpapi.save: API: save via an open synchronized session.
query.extend.where: Extend the session query WHERE clause.
attr.input: Session attribute: whether the current field accepts input.
attr.mandatory: Session attribute: whether the current field is mandatory.
attr.domain$: Session attribute: domain name of the current field.
attr.changed: Session attribute: whether the current field value changed.
on case: 3GL multiple-way decision: ON CASE expr / CASE n: / DEFAULT: / ENDCASE; use break to skip remaining CASE labels.
default: 3GL ON CASE: optional branch when no CASE expression matches.
break: Exit the innermost loop or stop evaluating same-level ON CASE labels.
continue: Skip to the next iteration of the innermost WHILE/FOR/REPEAT loop.
elif: Shorthand for ELSE IF cond THEN without an extra ENDIF (TIV 2330+).
db.retry: Lock/retry mode constant often passed to db.insert / db.update.
EFNAME: 114 EFNAME — Index could not be created
EROWCHANGED: 201 EROWCHANGED — Row changed by other user
ENOTINRANGE: 205 ENOTINRANGE — Value is out of range
EMLOCKED: 210 EMLOCKED — Record in mirroring is locked
ETRANSACTIONOPEN: 213 ETRANSACTIONOPEN — Transaction is started, but not updated
EUNALLOWEDCOMPNR: 214 EUNALLOWEDCOMPNR — Operation not allowed for a logical company
EAUDCORRUPT: 252 EAUDCORRUPT — An audit file is corrupt
EAUDLOCKED: 253 EAUDLOCKED — An audit file is locked
EAUDABORT: 254 EAUDABORT — Commit transaction on the audit server has failed.
EEXTENSIONHOOKERROR: 299 EEXTENSIONHOOKERROR — Error raised by hook in extension
ESQLSYNTAX: 302 ESQLSYNTAX — Syntax error in SQL statement
ESQLINDEXOUTOFDIMS: 308 ESQLINDEXOUTOFDIMS — Array column index out of range
ESQLCARDINALITYVIOLATION: 310 ESQLCARDINALITYVIOLATION — SQL subquery (with comparison) returns more than 1 row
EBDBON: 502 EBDBON — User already logged in to database
EBDBNOTON: 508 EBDBNOTON — Not logged on to a database
ELICENSEERROR: 515 ELICENSEERROR — License error or corrupt shared memory
EDELAYED: 517 EDELAYED — General error for delayed locking
EBDBDBCONNECTIONLOST: 522 EBDBDBCONNECTIONLOST — Connection to the database has been lost
EREFEXISTS: 605 EREFEXISTS — Delete failed due to reference
after.update.db.commit: 4GL program event: runs after a database commit in the session.
before.display.object: 4GL program event: runs before an object is displayed on the form.
init.field: 4GL field event: initialize the field when the form is shown.
before.display: 4GL field event: runs before the field value is displayed.
before.zoom: 4GL field event: runs before a zoom session is opened from the field.
before.checks: 4GL field event: runs before standard field checks.
domain.error: 4GL field event: handle domain validation errors for the field.
ref.input: 4GL field event: reference input handling for the field.
ref.display: 4GL field event: reference display handling for the field.
on.input: 4GL field event: runs during field input processing.
after.zoom: 4GL field event: runs after returning from a zoom session.
after.display: 4GL field event: runs after the field value is displayed.
before.form: 4GL form event: runs before the form is processed.
after.form: 4GL form event: runs after the form is processed.
before.group: 4GL group event: runs before a form group is processed.
after.group: 4GL group event: runs after a form group is processed.
main.table.io: 4GL parent section: main table database I/O events.
read.view: 4GL main table I/O: runs when reading a view.
before.read: 4GL main table I/O: runs before reading a record.
after.read: 4GL main table I/O: runs after reading a record.
before.write: 4GL main table I/O: runs before inserting a new record.
after.write: 4GL main table I/O: runs after inserting a new record.
after.skip.write: 4GL main table I/O: runs after a skipped write.
before.rewrite: 4GL main table I/O: runs before updating an existing record.
after.rewrite: 4GL main table I/O: runs after updating an existing record.
after.skip.rewrite: 4GL main table I/O: runs after a skipped rewrite.
before.delete: 4GL main table I/O: runs before deleting a record.
after.delete: 4GL main table I/O: runs after deleting a record.
after.skip.delete: 4GL main table I/O: runs after a skipped delete.
on.entry: 4GL zoom event: runs when entering a zoom.from session.
on.exit: 4GL zoom event: runs when exiting a zoom.from session.
